explanation: BibTeX found no `\cite` or `\nocite` in the document, so it had nothing to look up and the bibliography is empty. Cite something with `\cite{key}`, or add `\nocite{*}` to list every entry in your `.bib` file, or remove the `\bibliography` line until you have something to cite.
rawMessage: I found no \citation commands---while reading file main.aux
title: Nothing in the document is cited
